verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context and search layer for agents, so integrating with voice pipelines is a fair question for it. However, its documented framework integrations cover LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, Pipedream, Sim and Google Antigravity, with no LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs or other voice-pipeline integration. A roughly 0.5s fast search mode exists, but nothing ties it to real-time voice use, so the story is unevidenced.
